summary.name: Blackbox AI
summary.one_liner: Blackbox is an inference and GPU deployment platform that serves open-weight models, including gpt-oss-120b on a single NVIDIA B200 with optional end-to-end encryption, and offers agent-driven tuning and fine-tuning for enterprise workloads.
use_cases: Hosting open-weight models on dedicated or air-gapped infrastructure
Routing many LLMs through a single API endpoint
Running encrypted inference for sensitive workloads
Renting GPUs with team access controls and audit logs
Fine-tuning and reinforcement-learning an open-weight model on internal data
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Blackbox as a platform that either runs a customer-chosen open-weight model as a dedicated deployment or routes over 300 models through one endpoint. It claims one NVIDIA B200 serves gpt-oss-120b faster than SambaNova and Groq chips, with an encryption option end to end, citing Artificial Analysis data and a single-stream benchmark. It also offers GPU rental with scoped API keys, spend limits, SSH key checks, and a unified audit log across cloud providers. Additional offerings are forward-deployed engineers running an agent-driven optimization loop and agent-driven fine-tuning and reinforcement-learning post-training. The page body also contains an unrelated SSH explainer and what appears to be raw log output with encrypted payloads, which carry no product facts.
notable: Claims a single NVIDIA B200 serves gpt-oss-120b faster than SambaNova and Groq, with end-to-end encryption
Agent-driven engine tuning: reports 723.2 tokens/sec on one B200, up from about 480 in one agent run
Rented GPUs come with scoped API keys, spend limits, SSH key checks and a single audit log
Routes 300+ models through one endpoint or runs a dedicated or air-gapped deployment
caveats: Performance figures are self-reported and rely on a blackbox-run harness; the page does not publish pricing
Several offerings (dedicated deployments, GPU rental, fine-tuning) are described as engineer-assisted, so availability for self-serve users is unclear
